title: Creamy Lemon Orzo with Skinless Chicken Thighs
description: A light, lemony orzo dish with pan-seared skinless chicken thighs. Lower-calorie thanks to the skinless thighs and minimal cream.
steps: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Sear in olive oil over medium-high heat ~4 min per side until golden and cooked through. Rest.
In the same pan, soften onion and garlic.
Add orzo and toast for 1 minute.
Pour in stock and lemon zest, simmer 8-10 min until orzo is al dente and stock is mostly absorbed.
Stir in cream cheese, lemon juice, and spinach until wilted.
Slice chicken, top the orzo, and garnish with parsley.

title: Nandos Fakeaway with Sweet Potato Wedges and Tenderstem Broccoli
description: Peri-peri chicken thighs with crispy sweet potato wedges and charred tenderstem - Nandos at home.
steps: Preheat oven to 200C.
Toss sweet potato wedges with olive oil, smoked paprika and salt - spread on a tray.
Rub chicken thighs all over with peri-peri sauce, place skin-up on a second tray.
Roast both for 30-35 min, flipping wedges halfway, until chicken is cooked through and skin is crispy.
In the last 5 min, blanch tenderstem in boiling water 2 min, then char in a hot pan with olive oil for 2-3 min.
Serve with lemon halves to squeeze over.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef Barbacoa
description: Mexican-style slow-cooked shredded beef with chipotle, lime and adobo. Great for tacos, bowls, or burritos.
steps: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper.
Sear chunks in olive oil until browned all sides - work in batches.
Transfer to slow cooker.
Blend chipotles, garlic, cumin, oregano, cloves, lime juice, vinegar and beef stock until smooth.
Pour over beef, add bay leaves.
Cook on low 8 hours or high 4-5 hours until shreddable.
Discard bay leaves, shred with two forks, return to the cooking liquid.
Serve in tacos with coriander, diced onion and lime.

title: Chicken Breast Chow Mein
description: Quick weeknight stir-fried noodles with chicken breast and crunchy veg in a soy-sesame sauce.
steps: Cook noodles per packet, drain, toss with a little oil.
Whisk soy sauces, oyster sauce, sesame oil and sugar in a bowl.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
Stir-fry chicken 2-3 min until just cooked, set aside.
Add garlic and ginger to the wok for 20 seconds.
Add carrot and pepper, stir-fry 1-2 min.
Return chicken, add noodles, sauce, beansprouts and spring onions. Toss.
Add cornflour slurry, toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Nandos-Style Chicken Wrap
description: Peri-peri chicken, salad and a tangy mayo wrapped in a warm flour tortilla - like the Nandos wrap menu.
steps: Butterfly the chicken breasts, season, rub with peri-peri sauce.
Pan-fry in olive oil over medium-high 4 min per side until cooked through.
Rest 5 min, slice.
Mix mayo with 1 tsp peri-peri sauce.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
On each, spread peri mayo, layer lettuce, tomato, onion, sliced chicken and cheese.
Wrap tightly, slice in half.

title: Bacon and Egg Bagel
description: Toasted bagel with crispy bacon, a fried egg, melted cheese and a smear of brown sauce.
steps: Fry bacon in a dry pan until crispy, set aside.
Toast the bagel halves.
While they toast, fry the eggs in butter to your liking, runny yolks recommended.
On the bottom half of each bagel, add cheese, bacon, the egg, a grind of pepper, then a smear of brown sauce on the top half.
Close, eat.

title: Sushi Rice and Eggs
description: Japanese-inspired breakfast - sticky seasoned sushi rice topped with soft-set scrambled eggs, soy and furikake.
steps: Rinse rice until water runs clear, then cook with 240ml water in a rice cooker, or simmer covered 12 min then rest 10 min.
Mix vinegar, sugar and salt, fold through cooked rice, let cool slightly.
Beat eggs with soy and mirin.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat, add eggs, stir gently with a spatula for soft-set scramble - do not overcook.
Divide rice between two bowls, top with eggs, sprinkle furikake and spring onions, drizzle a little soy.

title: Classic Overnight Oats
description: The base recipe - creamy rolled oats soaked overnight in milk and yogurt, ready to grab in the morning.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a jar or container.
Stir well.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
In the morning, give it a stir, top with whatever you fancy such as berries, banana or nut butter, eat cold.

title: Peanut Butter and Banana Overnight Oats
description: Overnight oats variant with peanut butter, banana and a hint of cinnamon.
steps: Mash the banana into the milk and peanut butter until smooth-ish.
Stir in oats, yogurt, honey, chia, cinnamon and salt.
Decant into a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with extra banana slices and a drizzle of peanut butter to serve.

title: Berry and Almond Overnight Oats
description: Overnight oats variant with mixed berries, almond butter and flaked almonds.
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, almond butter, maple syrup, chia, vanilla and salt together in a jar until combined.
Refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with mixed berries and flaked almonds.
